title: tropaeolum peregrinum var. weberbaueri
intro: Tropaeolum peregrinum var. weberbaueri, commonly known as the 'Flowering Tropaeolum' or 'Mexican Tropic Flower', is a plant species belonging to the genus Tropaeolum, which is native to South America. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Tropaeolum peregrinum var. weberbaueri include wound healing, pain relief, and immune system modulation. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
